title: tier-2: seed a projection descriptor with default scales and cleared extents
notes: Zero named callees; pure leaf at 0x142075230 (Overwatch.exe / current build).
Stores 1.0f at +0x54/+0x58/+0x74/+0x78 and dword/qword zeros at +0x40/+0x4c/+0x5c/+0x64/+0x6c.
Generic random corpus is enough: every input is overwritten at the fixed offsets, so the mem channel sees the stores regardless of the starting bytes.
Return is the input pointer; declared void.
